From 31d00156e50ecad37f2cb6cbf04aaa9a260505ef Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 08:29:58 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: af_alg - Fix page reassignment overflow in
 af_alg_pull_tsgl

When page reassignment was added to af_alg_pull_tsgl the original
loop wasn't updated so it may try to reassign one more page than
necessary.

Add the check to the reassignment so that this does not happen.

Also update the comment which still refers to the obsolete offset
argument.

Reported-by: syzbot+d23888375c2737c17ba5@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Fixes: e870456d8e7c ("crypto: algif_skcipher - overhaul memory management")
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/crypto/af_alg.c b/crypto/af_alg.c
index 437f3e77c7e0..dd0e5be4d8c0 100644
--- a/crypto/af_alg.c
+++ b/crypto/af_alg.c
@@ -705,8 +705,8 @@ void af_alg_pull_tsgl(struct sock *sk, size_t used, struct scatterlist *dst)
 			 * Assumption: caller created af_alg_count_tsgl(len)
 			 * SG entries in dst.
 			 */
-			if (dst) {
-				/* reassign page to dst after offset */
+			if (dst && plen) {
+				/* reassign page to dst */
 				get_page(page);
 				sg_set_page(dst + j, page, plen, sg[i].offset);
 				j++;
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary

### Files Modified

1. **`crypto/af_alg.c`** (in function `af_alg_pull_tsgl`)
   - **Change**: In the inner loop (line 708), the condition `if (dst)` became `if (dst && plen)`.
   - **Comment update**: The comment changed from `/* reassign page to dst after offset */` to `/* reassign page to dst */`.

### Relationship Between Changes

- The single modification addresses an overflow bug: when `plen` (the length of the current scatterlist segment) is zero, the code should **not** attempt to reassign the page to `dst`. Previously, the check only verified that `dst` was non‑NULL, so it could reassign a zero‑length segment, leading to an unnecessary extra page reassignment beyond the intended number. Adding the `plen` guard prevents this off‑by‑one error.
- The comment change reflects that the obsolete `offset` parameter (which was removed in an earlier commit) is no longer relevant, so the comment is simplified.
